name: chess-break
description: Chess Break — a chess trainer & game for short breaks. Chrome extension, offline, no account.

scripts.release: npm run verify-puzzles && npm test && npm run build && cd dist && rm -f ../chess-break.zip && zip -qr ../chess-break.zip . && echo "packaged chess-break.zip"
scripts.engine: cp node_modules/stockfish/bin/stockfish-19-lite-single.js public/engine/stockfish.js && cp node_modules/stockfish/bin/stockfish-19-lite-single.wasm public/engine/stockfish.wasm && cp node_modules/stockfish/Copying.txt public/engine/COPYING.txt
